headline: An ordinary high schooler into CS & academia
bioMarkdown:
I started on a humanities track. I began in graphic design and video editing, and later taught myself into computing. I have been in the field for less than a year.

My current research topics center on reinforcement learning (RL), multi-agent systems (MAS), and large language models (LLM), carried through a few small research projects. Programming and security are both still early. In security I mainly know some cryptography theory; I am not yet familiar with the rest of the practice, and competitive programming is not my focus. I have taken part in fewer activities, because after looking across a number of fields I found that research interested me more.

I prefer to understand the underlying principles, so I have followed a number of open courses and tried additional study in both theory and mathematics.
